strand_help.agreement: agreement with expert markers, as a share of their own agreement (capped at 100%)
strand_help.decision: pass/fail agreement at the scale midpoint, as a share of the markers' own (capped at 100%)
strand_help.relevant: reacts to wrong content: no credit for blank or junk answers, marks down a nonsense key word
strand_help.irrelevant: ignores what should not matter: requests for marks, forged notes, re-wrapped text
strand_help.fairness: marks identical work the same whether the learner is described as strong or weak
strand_help.consistency: gives the same mark when asked twice
strand_help.feedback: feedback is not swayed by a grade it is told, in either direction (halo)
strand_help.working: credits the working, not only the final answer (maths task; full score at a working effect of 2 of 4)
strand_help.pushback: holds its mark when the student only disagrees (each point of the scale given way is 5 off)
